limits.en: Fully free and open source, no paid tier.

keyLimits.en: Fully free, open source under MIT license; no paid tier or usage cap.

capabilities.en: Statically analyzes JavaScript/TypeScript code to find problems and enforce code style.
Auto-fixes many problems with syntax-aware fixes, avoiding naive find-and-replace errors.
Supports custom parsers and user-defined rules alongside a large built-in rule set.
Works in browser or server-side JavaScript, with or without frameworks, and with JSX.

limitations.en: No built-in dashboard or team analytics; reporting and CI aggregation require third-party tooling.
Configuration and rule tuning require developer expertise, unlike zero-config alternatives.

missingAlternatives.name: Biome
missingAlternatives.reason: Fast all-in-one linter/formatter competing directly with ESLint, not in the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.name: Prettier
missingAlternatives.reason: Commonly paired with or compared to ESLint for JS/TS code quality, not in the catalogue.
